overview.title: ✨ saMacros API
overview.subtitle: Complete Script Programming Reference | v2.0.0+ | Developer Edition
overview.note-desc: Precise method signatures, parameter types, return types. Based on actual source code. For experienced developers.
overview.core-concepts-desc: saMacros v2.0.0+ provides a complete script API that allows you to deeply control macro recording and playback.
overview.concept-mm: mm Object - Global script entry point, provides event listening, logging and other basic functions
overview.concept-context: IScriptContext - Script execution context, access system and application information
overview.concept-events: Event System - Listen to lifecycle, recording, playback and other events
overview.concept-cancellable: Cancellable Events - Some events implement Cancellable interface, allowing interruption of operations
overview.package-content:
io.github.samera2022.samacros.api
├── IScriptAPI            - Script global object
├── IScriptContext        - Script execution context
├── IConfig               - Configuration interface
├── ISystemInfo           - System information
├── IScreenInfo           - Screen information
├── II18n                 - Internationalization
├── IMacroInfo            - Macro status
├── IMouseInfo            - Mouse information
├── event
│   ├── Event             - Event base class
│   ├── Cancellable       - Cancellable interface
│   └── events/           - 16+ concrete event classes
└── action
    └── IMouseAction      - Mouse action interface
overview.overview-row-2-content: simulate(), getPixelColor(), showToast() and 9 other methods
overview.overview-row-3-content: Get DPI scaling, screen information, coordinate conversion
overview.overview-row-4-content: 16+ events: lifecycle, recording, playback, input events
overview.overview-row-5-content: Cancellable event interruption, event listening best practices

quick-start.subtitle: Get Started with saMacros Scripts in 5 Minutes

script-api.title: Script API (mm Object)
script-api.subtitle: interface IScriptAPI - Global Script Entry Point
script-api.intro: The global mm object is your main interface to interact with saMacros.
script-api.method-on-param-1-desc: The full class name of the event, e.g., io.github.samera2022.samacros.api.event.events.BeforePlaybackStartEvent
script-api.method-on-param-2-desc: The callback function executed when the event is triggered, receives the event object
script-api.method-getcontext-body: Returns a context object containing all system interfaces, screen information, configuration, etc.
script-api.method-cleanup-body: Automatically called when the script is disabled. Use to close files, clear timers, release memory, etc.

context-api.title: Context API
context-api.subtitle: interface IScriptContext - Script Execution Context
context-api.method-simulate-param-desc: Mouse action object, usually from recorded macros
context-api.method-getpixelcolor-return-desc: AWT Color object, can use getRed(), getGreen(), getBlue() to get components
context-api.method-getpixelcolor-return: Color - AWT Color object, can use getRed(), getGreen(), getBlue() to get components
context-api.method-getmouseinfo-return-desc: Contains getPosition() method returning Point or null
context-api.method-getmouseinfo-return: IMouseInfo - Contains getPosition() method returning Point or null

system-api.title: System & Screen API
system-api.subtitle: ISystemInfo and IScreenInfo Interfaces
system-api.method-getscale-return: double[] - [scaleX, scaleY], usually the same value
system-api.method-getscreencount-example:
const screen = context.getScreenInfo();
mm.log('Number of monitors: ' + screen.getScreenCount());
system-api.method-normalize-title: Convert Physical Coordinates to Virtual Coordinates
system-api.method-denormalize-title: Convert Virtual Coordinates to Physical Coordinates

config-api.title: Configuration API
config-api.subtitle: interface IConfig - Application Configuration Reading
config-api.intro: Obtained via context.getAppConfig(). All methods accept String type keys.
config-api.method-getint-example:
const maxRetries = config.getInt('max_retry_count');
const timeout = config.getInt('timeout_ms');
config-api.method-getdouble-example:
const scaleFactor = config.getDouble('scale_factor');
const delayMultiplier = config.getDouble('delay_multiplier');
config-api.method-getstring-example:
const version = config.getString('app_version');
const language = config.getString('preferred_language');

macro-info.title: Macro Info API
macro-info.subtitle: interface IMacroInfo - Macro Status Query
macro-info.intro: Obtained via context.getMacroInfo(). Provides 4 status query methods.
macro-info.method-getactionscount-title: Get Number of Actions in Macro
macro-info.method-getactionscount-example:
const count = macro.getActionsCount();
mm.log('Total actions: ' + count);

i18n-api.title: Internationalization API
i18n-api.subtitle: interface II18n - Multi-language Support
i18n-api.intro: Obtained via context.getI18n(). Supports multi-language string queries.
i18n-api.method-get-return: String - Translation value in current language

event-system.subtitle: Event Base Class and Cancellable Interface

event-system.cancellable-desc: Some events implement Cancellable interface, allowing you to interrupt operations.
